#### 1. What the caller expresses, and how the simulator behaves

- *Object*: "he wants next spring's fertilizer money in before the year turns … he asks … to put in as much prepay as the programme will carry against next spring's fertilizer". He holds exactly one input account, so the object is unambiguous.
- *Timing*: "He dropped a signed prepay form at the Kellerton counter on Tuesday and now wants it taken" — act now, at the frozen moment.
- *Boundary*: he refuses a guessed amount — "he does not want a round figure off the top of somebody's head, he wants whatever the programme will actually carry for him" — and extends the boundary to the cooperative's own book-work: "they are welcome to sort out anything on his account that wants sorting while they are in there".
- *Authorisation*: "the booking itself is his money and he will be the one to put it in"; "When the booking is handed over for him to make he makes it there and then in his own name and reads back the booking number that comes off it." The booking call is user-owned.

Passive and conditional throughout: identity details only on request ("He offers neither until he is asked"); the desk's own reference refused ("he says he has no notion what number the desk gave it and they will have to find it on their own side"); the season's spend refused as a guess ("the desk had better read it off the record rather than take his guess"); one line not two ("If he is asked whether he wants it split across two classes he says no, one line will do"); "He names no other piece of work and raises no second subject." No policy or answer is leaked.

Identity: name, `M-33082`, and on a second request the mobile `5150330926`. `verify_member_identity({'customer_id':'c253ab5d-a917-46a5-a9f7-35a8d08b196c','member_number':'M-33082','phone_number':'5150330926'})` → **"Identity confirmed for c253ab5d-… (2 detail(s) matched the profile)."**

#### 4. Each scored parameter, its formula in words, inputs, intermediates, tiers and value

**(A) Season volume discount — baseline *season_spend_and_the_volume_discount_granted_0c95e7a3*.**
- Season window = "the 14 statement months before the handling date".
- Season spend = 239709.00 − 3335.94 = **236373.06**.
- Rate — **tiered** by *steady_buying_rates_on_the_season_volume_discount_a15fd3b8*: "eight or more deliveries were invoiced to the account over the 14 statement months … and the credit department's standing decision on the account is an approval, the volume discount rate is 2.25 percent". Eight deliveries (listed at item 3) and `credit_status: 'approved'` → **2.25 percent** (displacing the programme's 1.5 percent).
- Qualifying spend — **tiered** by *what_the_volume_discount_rate_is_taken_on_6df41ac2*. Twice the Full Acre threshold is 300000.00 and 236373.06 is below it, so the first band fails. Second band: "at or above the programme's volume discount threshold but below twice it and a perfected security interest covering the growing crop is recorded on the account, the rate is taken on the whole of the season spend less half of that threshold". 236373.06 ≥ 150000.00, and `lien_on_file: True` (the `find_agronomy_accounts` description calls this field "whether a security interest is on file") → 236373.06 − 75000.00 = **161373.06**.
- Delivered grain bonus — **tiered** by *grain_delivered_and_the_volume_discount_rate_3e8b06c1*: `find_grain_contracts` → `{'contract_number': 'GC-100914', 'status': 'active', 'open_bushels': 40000}` (a live grain marketing contract); `find_grain_ledger_entries` → three `grain_delivery_applied` rows inside the window, net bushels 13200.0 + 14050.5 + 11249.5 = **38500.0**, at or above 25000 → **0.50 percent**.
- Settlement record uplift — **tiered** by *settlement_record_uplift_on_the_volume_discount_cb27f85d*: six payments posted inside the 14 months, at least one by a transfer of grain settlement proceeds (`PY-928860`) → **0.40 percent**.
- Total rate, combined before it is applied = 2.25 + 0.50 + 0.40 = **3.15 percent**.
- **Discount granted = 161373.06 × 3.15 % = 5083.25.**
- Written against "the last invoice raised on the account in that season" = **`IN-4420488`** (2026-07-09).

**(B) Prepay booking taken — baseline *the_money_taken_on_a_prepay_booking_5a4c91f7*.**
- Prior season spend — **tiered** by *measuring_prior_season_spend_on_a_settled_account_ba7e40d6*: `opened_date: '2018-03-14'` → about 103 months open, "36 or more"; `acres_enrolled: 1540.0` against the Full Acre rebate threshold of 500 acres → "at or above the threshold". So "the prior season spend is half of everything invoiced to the account over the 26 statement months before the handling date, less every discount granted on the account". 441378.20 / 2 = 220689.10; discounts granted on the account = 1240.00 + 5083.25 = 6323.25 → **214365.85** (displacing the baseline's 14-month measure of 233385.75).
- Ceiling share — **tiered** by *ceiling_shares_where_the_crop_is_pledged_0f3d82c9*: "a perfected security interest covering the growing crop is recorded on the account and eight or more deliveries were invoiced to it over the 14 statement months before the handling date, the ceiling share is 120 percent" — `lien_on_file: True` and eight deliveries → **120 percent** (displacing the programme's 100 percent).
- Reduction for arrears — **tiered** by *cutting_the_prepay_ceiling_share_for_arrears_36ea7c14*: "a service charge stands assessed on the account over the 14 statement months … and a payment has also been posted to it over those months, the reduction taken off the ceiling share is 10 percent". The 115.49 charge of 2026-04-20 stands inside, and six payments stand inside → **10 percent**.
- Gross ceiling = 214365.85 × (120 % − 10 %) = 214365.85 × 1.10 = **235802.44**.
- Prepay already standing = 31000.00 − 23335.00 = **7665.00**.
- Share of it counted — **tiered** by *prepay_already_standing_counted_against_a_new_booking_c8195eb0*: prepay stands unapplied, and the Full Acre Input Financing Account is marked "yes" in that document's "Booked money drawable against another input class" table → **100 percent** = 7665.00.
- **Booking taken = 235802.44 − 7665.00 = 228137.44**, well above the Full Acre minimum booking of 10000.00.

#### 6. The problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

```
P2  grant the season volume discount earned on the crop year just closed   (first)
 ^  (P1 waits on P2)
P1  take the prepay booking at the ceiling the programme will carry        (last, the only thing he asked for)
```

**Hop P1 → P2. Marked: state-derived.**
Visible sentence, in the document of the problem he raised — *taking_a_prepay_booking_against_a_signed_request_17c6e8b3*: "**The money the cooperative will take on a prepay booking is fixed only after the account's ledger carries the volume discount earned on the input spend of the crop year just closed.**" It names a state of the ledger; it names no action, no performer, no tool and no other document.
Records: the only `agronomy_discount_granted` row on account `5191ed92-…` is `{'discount_type': 'prepay', 'discount_amount': 1240.0, 'posted_date': '2025-11-05'}`. No volume discount stands on the ledger, so the state does not hold.
Finding the write that brings it about: searching with the words the sentence and the record use — "volume discount", "granted", "the crop year just closed" — reaches *granting_the_season_volume_discount_f2b70d49*, whose own rule is "The volume discount a member has earned on a crop input account for the crop year just closed is granted once, after the season has closed, and is written against the last invoice raised on the account in that season", and which carries the write in its own invocation block; the amount comes from *season_spend_and_the_volume_discount_granted_0c95e7a3*. Neither document mentions the prepay booking, the prepay tool or any order of work — the connection is mine, from the sentence plus the ledger.

**Nothing remains.** *granting_the_season_volume_discount_f2b70d49* and *season_spend_and_the_volume_discount_granted_0c95e7a3* state no prerequisite sentence of their own, so P2 is a root and the tree closes at two problems.

**No hop was pre-solved.** Verified by search over `docs/agronomy/*.json`: `grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557` appears only in *granting_the_season_volume_discount_f2b70d49*; `book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27` only in *taking_a_prepay_booking_against_a_signed_request_17c6e8b3*; the prerequisite sentence appears in exactly one document, the blocked problem's own.

**Counter-proof on the problem tree — "he asked for a booking, so just take the booking".**
Excluded from visible sentences and records alone. *taking_a_prepay_booking_against_a_signed_request_17c6e8b3* states the money taken "is fixed only after the account's ledger carries the volume discount earned on the input spend of the crop year just closed"; the ledger carries no volume discount. Taking the booking first would take money the visible principle says is not yet fixed — and it would in fact be the wrong money, because *the_money_taken_on_a_prepay_booking_5a4c91f7* measures the prior season spend "less every discount granted on the account", so the 5083.25 changes the ceiling. Neither step of that reasoning uses a pointer, a tool name or a route.

**Counter-proof on the calculation — the fall-back number.**
Reading *the_money_taken_on_a_prepay_booking_5a4c91f7* alone with the product figures it names (the Full Acre row of the prepay catalogue insert: ceiling 100 percent of prior-year spend, smallest booking 10000.00) and applying no factor: prior season spend = 239709.00 − 6323.25 = 233385.75; ceiling share 100 percent; reduction nil; gross ceiling 233385.75; share of the standing prepay counted nil; booking = **233385.75**. Definite and different from 228137.44. For the volume discount the same exercise on *season_spend_and_the_volume_discount_granted_0c95e7a3* with the discount rate card gives: season spend 236373.06; qualifying spend 236373.06 − 150000.00 = 86373.06; rate 1.5 percent; bonus and uplift nil → **1295.60**, likewise definite and different from 5083.25.

#### 8. Ambiguities I had to resolve on the visible surface (recorded, not smoothed over)

1. **What counts as "everything invoiced to the account" over a window.** The baselines say "everything invoiced to the account over the fourteen statement months", and the ledger also carries `agronomy_prepay_booked` (31000.00, 2025-11-05) and `agronomy_prepay_applied` rows. I read "invoiced" as the `agronomy_invoice_issued` deliveries only — the corpus consistently describes prepay as money paid in ahead rather than a delivery invoiced (*prepay_money_taken_ahead_of_the_season_d70c53e8*: "Prepay is money the member pays in before the season against named product"). No visible sentence says so outright, so a reader could arguably include the booking.
2. **Whether the credit memo's `discount_amount` is "a discount granted on the account".** The 2026-06-20 credit memo row carries `'discount_amount': 370.66` inside it. I did not count it, because the corpus's "discounts granted" are the standalone `agronomy_discount_granted` lines that *the_three_discounts_a_crop_input_invoice_can_carry_8c4a2df0* describes. Counting it would move the prior season spend by 370.66.
3. **Gross bushels or net bushels for the delivered grain bonus.** *grain_delivered_and_the_volume_discount_rate_3e8b06c1* says "the bushels the cooperative has taken in from the member … and applied to delivery over that window", and the rows carry both `gross_bushels` (38547.83 in total) and `net_bushels` (38500.0). Both are far above the 25000 the tier turns on, so the answer is unaffected, but the document does not say which figure it means.
4. **A half-cent rounding.** The gross ceiling lands on 235802.435 before rounding. I applied "rounded half away from zero" (the phrase the tool schemas use) → 235802.44; a half-to-even reader would land on 235802.43 and then on a booking a cent low. No sentence of the baseline names the rounding mode for its own intermediate steps.
5. **`verify_member_identity` prose vs behaviour** — the same mismatch recorded at task 0 item 8.5: the description says the membership reference "never counts as one of those matching details", yet member number + mobile returns "2 detail(s) matched". Identity does clear, so the task is solvable; the mismatch is in a shared tool's description, not in this product's documents.

*No contamination.* No source-layer artefact, GT field or scored value was seen before this section was written to disk.

Every window, every tier, every intermediate and both prerequisite hops matched exactly. The **sole** divergence is the final cent of the prepay booking.

#### Verdict: KB-RUNTIME RED

**Symptom.** A solver who derives the booking from the published documents alone, using exact decimal arithmetic and the only rounding rule the visible materials state, arrives at 228137.44 where the scored value is 228137.43, and is marked wrong on the one write that carries this task.

**Root cause.** The gross ceiling lands exactly on a half cent — 214365.85 × 110 ÷ 100 = 235802.435 — and nothing a solver can see fixes which way a half cent goes at an *intermediate* step. The scored value is produced by `RND(prior_net_spend * net_share_pct / 100, 2)` evaluated over binary floats, where the product is representable as a shade under the half and rounds down. That is recoverable only from the hidden `compute`.

**Evidence.**
- The baseline document, *the_money_taken_on_a_prepay_booking_5a4c91f7*: "**Gross ceiling.** The gross ceiling is the prior season spend multiplied by the ceiling share less the reduction taken off it, that difference being taken as nil where it would fall below nil, and the product rounded to two decimal places." — "rounded to two decimal places", with no mode named. The same silence runs through every baseline of this product.
- The only rounding **mode** stated anywhere in the runtime-visible view is on the tool parameters, e.g. `book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27` → `booking_amount`: "in USD to 2 decimal places, a positive figure, **rounded half away from zero** to the cent at the moment of the call". Applying that rule to 235802.435 gives 235802.44.
- `agronomy.extended.yaml` → `agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling.compute`: `- gross_ceiling: RND(prior_net_spend * net_share_pct / 100, 2)` with `net_share_pct: MX(0, ceiling_share_pct - arrears_cut_pct)` = 110.0. In binary floating point `214365.85 * 110.0 / 100` evaluates to `235802.43499999998`, so `RND(…, 2)` yields 235802.43; under exact decimal arithmetic the same expression is 235802.435.
- `tasks/1.json` → `computations[1]`: `"expected": 228137.43`, and its `standing_prepay_offset` trace states the baseline alternative as "235802.43", confirming the gross ceiling the source used.

**Affected documents and locations.**
- `env/env_0003_farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/docs/agronomy/the_money_taken_on_a_prepay_booking_5a4c91f7.json` — the "Gross ceiling" step and, in principle, every "rounded to two decimal places" in the five baseline documents of this product: the rounding mode for an intermediate step is not carried.

**Nature of the defect (policy-side note).** The rendering carries the source's assembly step word for word; the bijection scan finds nothing wrong with it. The divergence comes from the source's own compute plumbing, where a half-cent intermediate is settled by the host language's float representation rather than by any stated rule. Recorded as a policy-side problem; it is **not** used to re-judge the rendering. It is nevertheless KB-RUNTIME RED, because the visible materials do not entail the scored value.

This is emphatically **not** a rollout agent's arithmetic slip: a correct exact-decimal derivation following the only stated rounding rule produces 228137.44.

#### Secondary observations carried over from the blind answer

- **Blind item 8.1 (prepay rows as "invoiced") resolved — my reading was right.** The source's `spend_recent` / `spend_two_season` bindings filter `event_type='agronomy_invoice_issued'`, so prepay bookings and drawdowns are excluded, as I assumed. The documents do not say so, but the answer is unaffected.
- **Blind item 8.2 (the credit memo's embedded `discount_amount`) resolved — my reading was right.** `discounts_standing` sums `event_type='agronomy_discount_granted'` only, giving 1240.00 + the volume discount. Unaffected.
- **Blind item 8.3 (gross vs net bushels) resolved as net**, with no effect on the tier.
- **Blind item 8.4 is the finding above.**
- **Blind item 8.5 confirmed — scenario-level, outside this product.** `blueprint/share_tools.py` `verify_member_identity` counts `member_number` among the matching details (`supplied` includes it; only the `customer_id` locator is excluded), contradicting its own docstring sentence "The membership reference is used only to pull the right profile up and never counts as one of those matching details". This persona offers exactly the membership number and the mobile, and the GT passes exactly those two. Reported as a cross-cutting note; it does not change this skill's verdict.

## revision_3 — re-audit, 2026-09-18

Revisions 1 and 2 above are preserved unaltered.

Source now at `agronomy.extended.yaml` sha256[:16] = `7e467c191418fb6a`, `task_tools.py` = `fb62107a7cae45c5`. Gate snapshot of 2026-09-18T16:00 cited, not run: DOCS OK, TRACEABILITY OK (17/0).

**The world was re-queried, not reused**, although the brief states neither world moved — the stale-value trap a sibling auditor reported is a real one and I took the warning. Re-querying confirms this task's ledger is unchanged from revision 2 at every row: `IN-4395110` at 861.98 / 101713.64, the two corrected due dates (2026-07-12, 2026-08-16), the credit memo of 2026-06-20 carrying `extended_amount` 3706.60, `discount_amount` 370.66 and `amount` −3335.94, and the prepay of 7665.00 standing.

### The residual I declined to sign off at revision 2 is now closed by a sentence

At revision 2 I recorded that "every discount granted on the account" was determined against counting the credit memo's embedded 370.66 only **by inference across three documents rather than by a sentence**, and that the misreading was decisive here — 227728.41 against the scored 228136.14. The source now says it outright, and the corpus carries it:

> *the_money_taken_on_a_prepay_booking_5a4c91f7*, **Prior season spend**: "…is everything invoiced to the account over the fourteen statement months before the handling date, less every discount granted on the account **as a discount line of its own, which is an early pay, volume, prepay or programme rebate discount and never the restocking charge withheld inside a credit memo**, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places."

and in the factor that substitutes for it:

> *measuring_prior_season_spend_on_a_settled_account_ba7e40d6*, **Clause**, in both substituting tiers, and again in the table ("less every discount line granted (an early pay, volume, prepay or programme rebate discount, and never the restocking charge withheld inside a credit memo)").

I re-confirmed the misreading the sentence now bars: counting the 370.66 would give a prior season spend of 213994.01 and a booking of **227728.41**, which is the figure the source auditor reproduced. It is now excluded by the text of the very step that performs the subtraction, on both the default path and the substituted path. **The revision-2 residual is closed.**

I also tested the qualification for over- and under-reach against the enumeration in *the_three_discounts_a_crop_input_invoice_can_carry_8c4a2df0* (early pay, volume, prepay) plus the programme rebate that sits outside the stacking basis: the four named kinds are exactly the discount kinds this product carries, so the sentence neither narrows nor widens what is summed. On this member's ledger it selects the prepay discount of 1240.00 and the volume discount of 5083.25 granted in this call, and excludes the 370.66 — which is what the derivation below uses.

### The render agent's fall-through call — judged, and correct

The source carries the qualification in **all three** tiers of `prior_season_spend_basis`, including the `otherwise` tier, whose method text restates the default measure. The published factor document carries it in the two substituting tiers only; its fall-through reads "In every other case no such alternative measure is taken on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts."

**The call is right, and it was the only faithful option.** The source's `otherwise` tier *is* the baseline — `baseline: {prior_net_spend: 'RND(spend_recent + discounts_standing, 2)'}` — and its prose restates the computation document's default. Writing it into the factor document would have required first restating that default there, which is exactly what makes a corpus non-discrete: a factor document that states the baseline tells a reader what the unmodified measure is without their ever going to the computation document. I checked the convention across the corpus rather than assuming it: **all twenty-two factor documents that carry an explicit fall-through use the "no substitution" form** — "no substituted ceiling share applies", "no buying rate is substituted", "no such widening applies", "no relief is taken", and so on — and not one restates its computation document's default. The revert kept this document consistent with the other twenty-three.

Nothing is lost by it, and I verified that mechanically: every occurrence of "discount granted on the account" on this task's path now carries the qualification — twice in the factor document, once in the computation document — and there is no path through the corpus on which a reader of the prepay ceiling meets the phrase unqualified. The fall-through restates no measure, so there is nothing in it to qualify.

Prior season spend: 36+ whole months open counted to the handling date, 1540.0 acres above the 500-acre rebate threshold → half of the 26-month total 441375.84 = 220687.92, **less the discount lines 1240.00 + 5083.25 = 6323.25** (the 370.66 excluded by the new sentence) → **214364.67**. Ceiling share 120 % less the 10 % arrears cut → gross ceiling 214364.67 × 110 % = **235801.14**. Prepay standing 7665.00 counted at 100 % → **booking taken 228136.14**, above the 10000.00 minimum.
